# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Use the provided ExamDesk visual direction for the Razor Pages UI: IBM Plex Sans typography, navy sidebar, teal accent, responsive layout, light/dark theme support, compact cards/tables, accessible focus states, and mobile-friendly navigation. Keep real server-side Razor Pages data and authentication instead of the reference's in-memory JavaScript data.
- Display both Admin and Student options on the website before login, rather than hiding role sections until after authentication.
